scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ims/api" "npm run dev -w @ims/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ims/shared && npm run build -w @ims/api && npm run build -w @ims/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ims/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ims/api && npm run typecheck -w @ims/web
